system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a Helm chart deploying a Redis cache: StatefulSet, headless Service, PersistentVolumeClaim, and a Secret for the Redis password.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a Redis cache: StatefulSet, headless Service, PersistentVolumeClaim, and a Secret for the Redis password.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: redis
description: Production-grade Redis cache Helm chart
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "7.2.4"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: redis
  tag: "7.2.4-alpine"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  port: 6379
persistence:
  enabled: true
  storageClassName: ""
  size: 8Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 999
  fsGroup: 999
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
redisPassword: "change-me-in-production"
---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis.fullname" . }}-secret
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "redis.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
type: Opaque
stringData:
  password: {{ .Values.redisPassword | quote }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis.fullname" . }}-headless
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "redis.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  clusterIP: None
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: redis
      protocol: TCP
      name: redis
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "redis.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
---
# FILE: templates/statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "redis.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  serviceName: {{ include "redis.fullname" . }}-headless
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "redis.name" . }}
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "redis.name" . }}
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          args:
            - "--requirepass"
            - "$(REDIS_PASSWORD)"
          ports:
            - name: redis
              containerPort: {{ .Values.service.port }}
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "redis.fullname" . }}-secret
                  key: password
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes: {{ .Values.persistence.accessModes }}
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.persistence.storageClassName | quote }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.persistence.size }}
